description: This file defines a SwiftUI ViewModifier called GatewayTrustPromptAlert which presents an alert to trust a gateway connection, along with an extension on View to apply this modifier.

classes.name: GatewayTrustPromptAlert
classes.description: A SwiftUI ViewModifier that shows a trust prompt alert based on the GatewayConnectionController's trust prompt state.

methods.name: body
methods.description: Builds the view with an attached alert that prompts the user to trust the gateway.

methods.name: promptBinding
methods.description: Creates a binding to the pending trust prompt, keeping the state until user action.
